column2: Close-up of a woman in her thirties with freckles and auburn hair, she turns her head toward the camera and smiles softly, window light, shallow depth of field, realistic.
Medium shot of an elderly man with a grey beard sitting at a cafe table, he looks up from his newspaper and laughs, warm afternoon light, realistic film look.
Two friends, a young man and a young woman, talk while walking down a city sidewalk at dusk, faces lit by shop windows, handheld tracking shot, realistic.
